title: minuartia tenuifolia subsp. hybrida
intro: Minuartia tenuifolia subsp. hybrida, commonly known as Alpine Pennycress, is a flowering plant species within the genus Minuartia. This plant has been used to treat various health issues due to its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of arthritis and other inflammatory conditions. The therapeutic actions of Alpine Pennycress include its ability to reduce inflammation, modulate the immune system, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its therapeutic effects.
